theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_pp_hs_proj_split
theorems.statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (X : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), hsNormSq X = hsNormSq (X ∘L K.starProjection) + hsNormSq (X ∘L Kᗮ.starProjection)) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (K L : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), hsNormSq (K.starProjection - L.starProjection) = hsNormSq ((K.starProjection - L.starProjection) ∘L K.starProjection) + hsNormSq ((K.starProjection - L.starProjection) ∘L L.starProjection)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
